docs.authorization_process: Access to ePHI systems is requested in the ITSM tool, granted on a least-privilege role basis, and approved before provisioning; access is recertified quarterly.
docs.supervision_process: Workforce members with ePHI access are assigned a supervising manager who reviews activity reports monthly; contractors are escorted or session-monitored.
docs.approver_role: System Owner (with Security Official countersignature for privileged roles)
